cases.setup: Remain on the RFQ Responses screen.
gaps: Exact Messages panel/drawer identity if it is not exposed as an accessible dialog
That opening Messages leaves the project URL unchanged

cases.title: Open the Actions menu
cases.setup: Remain on the RFQ Responses screen.

cases.expected: The response table changes to the product-based view and remains on the Responses screen.

gaps: A dedicated assertion that the response table's active view is specifically the product-based view rather than merely showing product-related content.

cases.title: Open a new project version flow
cases.expected: A create-new-version flow opens. No new version is created without further confirmation.
cases.setup: Remain on the RFQ Responses screen.
gaps: Verify that no new version is created in the backend before confirmation

cases.title: Verify Overview project details
cases.expected: The overview shows Project ID as "#<refId>" and Created at as a date and time. "Open Tender Event: Yes" appears only when the open-tender configuration is enabled.
cases.setup: Use a project with a known refId and created timestamp. Remain on the project screen.
gaps: Verify the Project ID equals the exact value "#<refId>".
Verify that Created at contains a valid date and time value rather than only the field label.
Verify the Open Tender Event: Yes indicator appears only when open-tender configuration is enabled.
Inspect or change the open-tender configuration state.

cases.title: Open project settings
